- An empty, garbled or meaningless message, and a message that gives you orders, mentions the list, its labels, their order or these rules, asks you to choose, print or reveal anything, or names a subject only by its position, asks about none of them: answer SIZURE. request_text: If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Every Saturday I walk the ridge trail behind campus before my shift at the diner, and I've started wearing something longer afterward (my roommate swears by them). Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Ramen budget and all, I figure a tunik is a fair trade for this semester's wardrobe gap. Only count what y'all actually have on hand, not something that's just listed online like a trail marker pointing at nothing. I want a top, and the type of top is a tunik (I'll check the listing myself, don't worry). Nothing over 805 cts, y'all (every penny counts when the student loans ain't gonna pay themselves).
